kunjaban.name: Kunjaban
kunjaban.about:
Kunjaban is a locality and municipal ward in the North zone of Agartala, set on a green hillock where the city rises from the Haora plains into low hills. Its main landmark is the old palace on the hill, built in 1917 and later used as the Governor's residence until 2018, which is now being turned into a cultural museum. The Agartala Municipal Corporation's North zone office stands at Kumari Tilla in Kunjaban, and Chanmari, Indranagar and Abhoynagar are among the other North zone wards around it.

Kunjaban lies just north of the palace area at the centre, so tutors from the central and northern wards can both reach it. Tell the tutor whether the home is a house on a lane or a flat in a building with a gate, and share a landmark on the hill road. Autos and city buses are the usual way in, and many tutors ride a two-wheeler, which is easier to park on the inner roads. Office-hour traffic towards the centre is worth avoiding when you fix a slot. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

indranagar.name: Indranagar
indranagar.about:
Indranagar is a census town and municipal ward in the North zone of Agartala, recorded with a population of a little under eighteen thousand at the 2001 census. The locality is known across the city for its Kali temple, which draws worshippers every day and holds a three-day fair at Diwali, and an industrial training institute is another local landmark. Dhaleswar and Banamalipur lie close by, and Abhoynagar and Kunjaban are among the other North zone wards.

Because it sits between the northern wards and the Dhaleswar side, Indranagar is easy to reach for tutors living in Abhoynagar, Kunjaban, Dhaleswar or Banamalipur, and that makes it simpler to keep weekday classes regular. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto. Give a clear lane landmark, such as the temple, along with a phone number for the first visit. The roads around the temple are crowded during the Diwali fair, so plan around those days or switch to an online class that week, and use online sessions for specialist subjects when the right tutor lives across the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

abhoynagar.name: Abhoynagar
abhoynagar.about:
Abhoynagar, also written Abhaynagar, is a locality and municipal ward in the North zone of Agartala. It is home to a historic shrine established in the late nineteenth century during the time of the Manikya rulers, and it is the main venue in the state for an annual spring festival that the Tripura government recognised as an official state festival in 2015. Kunjaban, Indranagar, Nandannagar and Radhanagar are among the other North zone wards around it.

For families, Abhoynagar sits on the northern side of the city, so tutors from Kunjaban, Indranagar and Banamalipur are the nearest pool, and tutors from central Krishnanagar can also reach it without a long trip across town. Tutors usually come by two-wheeler or auto; share a lane landmark and phone number before the demo class. On festival days the roads near the shrine get busy, so agree a regular slot that can shift on those dates. Online classes are a practical option for subjects such as higher-level maths or physics when a specialist lives elsewhere in Agartala. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

krishnanagar.name: Krishnanagar
krishnanagar.about:
Krishnanagar is one of the most densely populated parts of Agartala and lies almost in the middle of the city, in the Central zone of the municipal corporation, with Paschim Krishnanagar as a neighbouring ward. Ujjayanta Palace, the royal palace of 1901 that housed the state legislative assembly and is now the state museum, stands on its western side. Several of the city's most visited temples, including the Jagannath and Laxmi Narayan temples and the Durgabari, lie within or right beside the locality, and the state road transport terminus and district offices are close by.

Krishnanagar has busy streets of shops and eateries and a weekly market held every Tuesday and Friday. Being central, it is within easy reach of tutors from Banamalipur, Ramnagar, Kunjaban and Dhaleswar, and city buses and autos run through the area. Tell the tutor whether the home is a house in a lane or a flat with a gate, and where to park; a two-wheeler is far simpler than a car here. Avoid market evenings and office closing time when choosing a slot. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ramnagar.name: Ramnagar
ramnagar.about:
Ramnagar is a locality on the north-western side of Agartala and one of the earliest planned neighbourhoods in Tripura. Its rectangular gridiron layout dates from the time of the Rajas, and the area is divided into about twelve numbered divisions, known as Ramnagar No. 1, Ramnagar No. 2 and so on. It forms a municipal ward in the Central zone, with Ranjitnagar, Rajnagar and Paschim Jaynagar among the neighbouring wards.

The numbered divisions make Ramnagar easy for a new tutor to find: share the division number and a landmark, and the first visit rarely goes wrong. Tutors from Joynagar, Krishnanagar and the other central wards can reach it easily by two-wheeler or auto. Say whether the home is a house, where the tutor can come to the door, or a flat that needs a call to the family at the gate. Keep evening classes clear of the busiest market hours on the main roads. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

banamalipur.name: Banamalipur
banamalipur.about:
Banamalipur is a locality in central Agartala that, together with Dimsagar, forms one of the municipal wards of the Central zone. It also gives its name to an assembly constituency created in 1977, which is part of the Tripura West parliamentary seat. Dhaleswar lies next to it on the east, Indranagar is close by, and Krishnanagar and the palace area are its neighbours towards the city centre.

Its position between the centre and the eastern wards makes Banamalipur easy for tutors coming from Krishnanagar, Dhaleswar, Indranagar or Abhoynagar, so families here can look for a tutor in several nearby localities. Most tutors travel by two-wheeler or auto. For the first class, send the tutor a lane landmark and a phone number, and say whether the home is a house with doorstep arrival or a flat with a building gate. Roads towards the centre are busier at office hours, so an early-evening slot fixed for the week tends to work smoothly, with online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

joynagar.name: Joynagar
joynagar.about:
Joynagar, written Jaynagar in the municipal ward list, is a long-established locality on the western side of Agartala, in the Central zone of the municipal corporation. It is both a residential area and a busy market place, and its closest landmark is Battala Bazaar, one of the largest markets in the state. Joynagar Lake, a local bus stand and the immersion ghat used during Durga Puja are other local landmarks, and Ramnagar lies to its north.

For home tuition, Joynagar's central-western position means tutors from Ramnagar, Krishnanagar and Melarmath can reach it without difficulty. The streets around Battala Bazaar are crowded through the day and especially in the evening, so ask the tutor to come by two-wheeler, give a landmark in the lane rather than at the market, and choose a slot away from the evening rush. Arrival is usually at the doorstep for houses and at the gate for flats. During the Durga Puja immersion days, processions pass through the area, so move classes online for those dates. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

melarmath.name: Melarmath
melarmath.about:
Melarmath is a locality and municipal ward in the Central zone of Agartala, close to the city centre and to Town Pratapgarh and Shantipara among the neighbouring wards. The city's first flyover, opened in 2019, runs from Police Lines in southern Agartala to Fire Brigade Chowmuhani in the centre and passes through Melarmath, so the locality sits on the main link between the central and southern parts of the city.

That flyover is useful for tutors: someone living in the southern wards around Badharghat, Arundhutinagar or Pratapgarh can reach Melarmath quickly, and tutors from Krishnanagar and Joynagar are also close. Share the house or building name and a landmark, and check whether the tutor can park a two-wheeler at the door. Central roads are busiest at office opening and closing times, so fix a regular weekday slot outside those hours, and consider online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dhaleswar.name: Dhaleswar
dhaleswar.about:
Dhaleswar, also spelt Dhaleshwar, is a residential locality in the East zone of Agartala, close to Banamalipur, Indranagar, Kalyani and Math Chowmuhani. It has its own post office, comes under the East police station, and the Agartala Municipal Corporation runs a primary health centre here. The corporation's East zone office is at Ashram Chowmuhani in Dhaleswar, and Kashipur-Khayerpur and Shibnagar are among the other East zone wards.

Dhaleswar has several schools and a settled residential character, which is why many families here look for a regular home tutor through the school year. Tutors from Banamalipur, Indranagar, Shibnagar and the central wards can reach it easily by two-wheeler or auto. Use a chowmuhani, such as Ashram Chowmuhani or Math Chowmuhani, as the landmark for the first visit, and say whether the home is a house or a flat. School opening and closing hours bring extra traffic on the local roads, so a later afternoon or early evening slot is usually smoother. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

shibnagar.name: Shibnagar
shibnagar.about:
Shibnagar is a locality in the East zone of Agartala, divided into two municipal wards, Shibnagar and Paschim Shibnagar, with Dhaleswar and Kashipur-Khayerpur among the neighbouring East zone wards. The locality is home to a historic mosque that the West Tripura district tourism list describes as notable for its unusual architecture, one of the better-known landmarks on the eastern side of the city.

For parents, Shibnagar's position between Dhaleswar and the centre means tutors from Dhaleswar, Banamalipur and Krishnanagar can take on classes here without a long trip, and tutors living in the Jogendranagar wards are also close. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or auto. Say which of the two Shibnagar wards you live in, and give a lane landmark and phone number for the first visit; houses usually allow doorstep arrival, while flats may need a call at the gate. Agree a fixed weekday slot, and use online classes when the right subject specialist lives on the far side of the city. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

jogendranagar.name: Jogendranagar
jogendranagar.about:
Jogendranagar is a census town on the eastern side of Agartala and part of the municipal corporation's East zone, where it spreads across the Jogendranagar, Uttar Jogendranagar and Purba Jogendranagar wards, with Aralia alongside. It had a population of close to thirty-five thousand at the 2001 census. Jogendranagar railway station, on Station Road in the Subhash Nagar area, lies on the broad-gauge Lumding to Sabroom line and has passenger trains towards Agartala, Dharmanagar and Silchar.

With three wards and its own station, Jogendranagar is one of the larger residential areas of the city. Tutors from Shibnagar, Dhaleswar and the central wards can reach it by two-wheeler or auto, and the passenger trains are an option for tutors living near Agartala station. Tell the tutor which of the Jogendranagar wards you are in and give a landmark near Station Road or the nearest market. Plan evening classes around the busiest times on the main roads, and keep online classes in mind for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

badharghat.name: Badharghat
badharghat.about:
Badharghat, also written Badarghat, is a census town on the southern side of Agartala that recorded a population of over forty-seven thousand at the 2001 census. In the municipal corporation it forms the Bhattapukur-Badarghat and Dakkhin Badarghat wards of the South zone, and the corporation's South zone office stands near the TV Centre at Badharghat. Arundhutinagar, Bardowali and Siddhi Ashram are among the neighbouring South zone wards.

Agartala railway station, opened in 2008 and rebuilt for broad gauge in 2016, is listed at Badharghat; it is the main station for the city, with trains on the Lumding to Sabroom line and long-distance services to other parts of India. The station area brings extra traffic at train times, so tutors should allow some margin. Families here can find tutors in Arundhutinagar, Pratapgarh and the other southern wards, and the flyover from the south makes the city centre easier to reach for tutors coming the other way. Say whether the home is a house or a flat and share a landmark. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

arundhutinagar.name: Arundhutinagar
arundhutinagar.about:
Arundhutinagar is a locality in the southern part of Agartala and a large one in municipal terms, covering two wards of the South zone of the city corporation. Badharghat, Bardowali, Siddhi Ashram and Rajlaxminagar are among the neighbouring South zone wards. The locality is home to the oldest church in Agartala, a Baptist church established in the 1930s, which is a well-known landmark on this side of the city.

As it sits in the southern wards, Arundhutinagar is most convenient for tutors who live in Badharghat, Pratapgarh or the other South zone localities, and the flyover that starts at Police Lines in southern Agartala helps tutors coming from the city centre. Most tutors use a two-wheeler or auto. Mention which part of Arundhutinagar you live in, since it spans two wards, and give a nearby landmark and phone number for the first visit. Houses usually mean doorstep arrival, while flats may need a word with the guard. For specialist subjects, online classes widen the choice of tutor. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

pratapgarh.name: Pratapgarh
pratapgarh.about:
Pratapgarh is a census town that has become part of Agartala, recorded with a population of nearly twenty-six thousand at the 2001 census. In the municipal corporation it spreads across three wards: Town Pratapgarh in the Central zone, and Paschim Pratapgarh and Purba Pratapgarh in the South zone. Melarmath and Shantipara are its central neighbours, while Rajlaxminagar, Arundhutinagar and Badharghat lie on the southern side.

Because it stretches from the centre towards the south, Pratapgarh can draw on tutors from both the central and southern wards, and the flyover between southern Agartala and the centre makes crossing the city easier. Tell the tutor whether you live in Town, Paschim or Purba Pratapgarh, as the three parts are spread out, and give a clear landmark. Most tutors come by two-wheeler or auto; houses allow doorstep arrival, while flats may need a call at the gate. Fix a weekday slot that avoids office rush on the main roads, and use online classes for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

North Agartala.fact: The Agartala Municipal Corporation groups the city's wards into four zones (North, South, East and Central); Kunjaban, Chanmari, Indranagar, Nandannagar, Abhoynagar and Radhanagar are North zone wards.
Agartala lies on plain land along the Haora River, but the city extends into low hills on its northern side.
The AMC North zone office is at Kumari Tilla, Kunjaban.
Pushbanta Palace on the Kunjaban hillock was built in 1917, served as Raj Bhavan until 2018 and is being converted into a cultural museum.
The Government of Tripura designated Meitei Umang Lai Haraoba an official state festival in January 2015; Abhoynagar is its main venue in the state.
Maharaja Bir Bikram Airport at Singerbhil, north-west of the city, opened a new integrated terminal on 4 January 2022.

Central Agartala.fact: Central zone wards include Ranjitnagar, Rajnagar, Paschim Jaynagar, Ramnagar, Paschim Krishnanagar, Krishnanagar, Dimsagar-Banamalipur, Town Pratapgarh, Shantipara and Melarmath.
Ujjayanta Palace was built in 1899-1901, housed the Tripura Legislative Assembly from 1973 to 2011 and has housed the state museum since 25 September 2013.
Ramnagar has a rectangular gridiron layout from the time of the Rajas and is divided into about twelve numbered divisions.
Agartala's first flyover, opened in 2019, runs from Police Lines (Drop Gate) to Fire Brigade Chowmuhani through Melarmath.
Battala Bazaar, next to Joynagar on the western side of the city, is one of the largest markets in Tripura.
The AMC Central zone office is in the City Centre Complex.

East Agartala.fact: East zone wards include Dhaleswar, Kashipur-Khayerpur, Shibnagar, Paschim Shibnagar, Jogendranagar, Uttar Jogendranagar, Aralia and Purba Jogendranagar.
The AMC East zone office is at Ashram Chowmuhani, Dhaleswar.
Jogendranagar railway station (JGNR) is on the broad-gauge Lumding-Sabroom line; it opened in 2008 and was rebuilt in 2016.
Jogendranagar had a population of 34,844 at the 2001 census.
Dhaleswar is close to Banamalipur, Indranagar, Kalyani and Math Chowmuhani and comes under the East police station.

South Agartala.fact: South zone wards include Bardowali, Bhattapukur-Badarghat, Arundhutinagar (two wards), Dakkhin Badarghat, Siddhi Ashram, Rajlaxminagar, Paschim Pratapgarh and Purba Pratapgarh.
The AMC South zone office is near the TV Centre, Badharghat.
Agartala railway station (AGTL), opened in 2008, is listed at Badharghat; the Agartala-New Delhi Tripura Sundari Express inaugurated broad-gauge services on 31 July 2016.
Badharghat had a population of 47,660 at the 2001 census.
The Baptist church in Arundhutinagar, established in the 1930s, is the oldest church in Agartala.
